vetSays.line: 📋 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
🛡️ Harper, Morris, Jayden, Nurzhamal and Katarina met them at the door — 5 put down. Harper, Morris, Jayden, Nurzhamal, Katarina are hurt.
🛡️ Harper, Morris, Jayden and Nurzhamal met them at the door — 4 put down. Harper, Morris, Jayden are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nurzhamal just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Harper, Morris, Jayden and Faical met them at the door — 4 put down. Harper, Jayden, Faical are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nurzhamal just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nurzhamal just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Harper, Morris, Jayden, Nurzhamal and Faical met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 barely walked away. Harper, Morris, Jayden, Nurzhamal are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Brian just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Ethan taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
Ethan is showing everyone European Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.

⚠️ Two threats: Elder The Focus Group and an eye-head (×4) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Rosa strikes the Elder The Focus Group.
The Elder The Focus Group falls.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rosa just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Big Ugly falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Big Ugly!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Olivia just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Mahmuda and Olivia met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Mahmuda is hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
